name: Mission in Space: The Lost Colony
summary:
Control up to 6 troopers and deliver a colony from an alien threat in this turn based tactical. Mission in Space: the lost colony is a turn based tactical game in which you control up to 6 troopers and deliver a colony from an alien threat.

There's 12 different missions with various objectives, 40 upgrades, 18 badges, 2 difficulty settings.
